command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts:tests HATCH_GLTF_VALIDATOR_ROOT=<offline-validator-directory> python -m unittest -v test_model3d_original_filename_bounds
setup: Two genuine native GLBs from an explicitly synthetic box, each packed, independently validated offline, published to a temporary local registry, read back and checked against the original bytes and acquisition name.
ordinary_control: blue-box.glb reached build_asset and validated geometry and payloads through validate_file.
regression: A 129-character ASCII filename survived native registration and import_canonical but build_asset raised MODEL3D_SCHEMA on the retained original_filename.
limits: The module checks native GLB registration and the document bridge. It does not exercise Blender, browser rendering, third-party services or production artwork.
